name: Xinxiang Richful Lube Additive Co.,Ltd.
summary: Xinxiang Richful Lube Additive Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of fine chemical products in China and internationally. The company provides lubricant additive-components, such as detergent, dispersant, ZDDP, viscosity index improver, and others; and lubricant oil additive-packages, including automotive engine oil, industrial oil, agricultural machine fluid, and marine oil additive package. It also offers grease thickener and esters; and specialty additives comprising resin color developer, rubber and plastic additive, emulsifier, and fuel additives. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Xinxiang, China.
